title: Import, Repair, Migration, Pack, Version, Review & Publication Lifecycle

selection_basis.parallel_lanes: GPR-05 and OARC-04 remain independently selected_not_started; MSAS-21 remains terminal completed_verified.

objective: Author the rule/content definition lifecycle and interchange seam for legacy import/repair, deterministic batch-edit preview, versioned/reversible migration where owner contracts permit, pack compilation/dependency manifests, review and permission-gated publication while deferring generic identity, rights, provenance, version/review and import-export infrastructure to ARI/PCA.
acceptance: legacy import preserves source text and unresolved gaps rather than inventing missing semantics
batch edit previews deterministic affected-set evidence before commit
migration is versioned and reversible where the owner contract permits
rights and provenance checks defer to ARI/PCA authority
publication cannot bypass approvals or permissions
boundaries: MRCS-19 owns rule/content domain mapping, pack compilation, dependency manifests and migration behavior; it does not create a parallel generic provenance/version/review/import-export engine.
ARI/PCA retain generic identity, source/derivative lineage, rights/use capability, provenance, version/review and import-export authority.
Legacy repair preserves source text, source values/prices, aliases/history and unresolved source gaps rather than inventing semantics.
Batch edits expose a deterministic affected-set preview before any commit path.
Migration reversibility is explicit and limited by the owning domain contract.
Unknown rights, provenance, dependencies, migration semantics or source gaps remain unresolved rather than inferred.
Publication remains approval- and permission-gated; optional AI cannot publish or canonize.
MRCS-21 remains unauthorized until separately selected; GPR and OARC lane state remains independent.
next_action: On an MRCS-specific owner Continue, fresh-read the MRCS-19 dependency closure and mrcs lane-state ref, then start and execute the bounded tranche under OPS3-11 milestone-only execution.
